description: This PHP class `SaveWorkShiftController` is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically within the Admin Controller namespace. It extends an abstract Vue controller and manages the rendering of a Vue component related to saving or editing work shifts. The class checks for an 'id' attribute in the request to determine whether to load an existing work shift for editing or set up default configuration for creating a new work shift.

classes.name: SaveWorkShiftController
classes.description: Controller responsible for rendering the Vue component related to saving or editing a work shift, based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component to be rendered. Decides whether to load an existing work shift or initialize default configuration based on the presence of an 'id' request attribute.
